description: frontend API modules, independent types, and TanStack Query hooks
spec:
1. Define frontend API types independently in frontend/src/api/types.ts.
2. Add an API module per domain using native fetch (no Axios).
3. Add TanStack Query hooks for listing, creating, updating, and archiving habits.
4. Add hooks for check-in toggle and habit stats.
5. Confirm the frontend does not import from the backend workspace.
6. Verify query invalidation refreshes lists after mutations.
title: Frontend API client and types
